reason: I already reorder my own brand when it runs out and I don't want to switch for a magnesium I haven't tried. Two capsules every day is also one more thing to remember on top of everything else.
objection: Two capsules a day for $30 is a lot for something I already have a routine for. I'd be paying to test a brand I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A much cheaper first box, like $15, or a single capsule a day, so trying it costs me almost nothing.
